MODELO.DICA: On official WhatsApp, 24 hours after the customer's last message, free text can't be sent. Pick a Meta-approved template to send instead; Meta charges for each template sent. With the window open, the text above is sent.

MODELO.SEM_MODELOS: No official WhatsApp inbox you can see has an approved utility template. Create and approve one in Templates.
MODELO.DIVERGENTE: This template has different text in another inbox. Each conversation gets its own inbox's template; if it asks for other variables there, the message is not sent.
MODELO.MUDOU: The template now asks for {quantas} variables. Fill in all of them before saving.
MODELO.SUMIU: The template {nome} is no longer approved as utility in the inboxes you can see. Pick another.
